verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly documents MCP support: 'Connect Warp AI to any tool via the Model Context Protocol' and MCP servers 'extend Warp's local agents in a modular, flexible way by exposing custom tools or data sources through a standardized interface — essentially acting as plugins for Warp,' plus the Oz CLI lets you 'Connect agents to MCP servers like GitHub and Linear.' This directly matches the story of plugging in MCP servers so the product's agent can use their tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of MCP tool usage in practice.
